title: ReplyDraft
description: Output of the Amilos reply agent. Version stored on every decision (row 14).

prompt_version.description: Opaque string identifying the prompt template used.

template_id.description: ID of the approved template used to generate this draft.

body.description: Plain-text reply body. Must not contain invented prices, legal promises, or dates not in template variables.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the reply language.

decision_hash.description: Deterministic hash tying this draft to the triage decision that triggered it.
